scope: Shared data and required native lifecycle outcomes; this file does not simulate or prove transactions

scenarios.requirement: Preparation leaves the active ledger and its key unchanged.
Cancel or preparation failure discards only the owned candidate.
A second connection edit after preparation prevents stale installation.
Restore/recreation invalidates an earlier prepared candidate even if revision repeats.
Changed encrypted rows, descriptors or receipt bytes reject before publication.
Restart before the pointer transaction exposes the previous complete ledger.
A pending valid new generation is authenticated on restart before it is exposed.
A pending invalid new generation may recover its authenticated recorded predecessor.
A verified new generation remains active after restart.
Corruption without a pending transition locks the vault; it does not silently select old history.
An exporter lease retains old receipt files while the replacement is active.
Candidate or garbage cleanup preserves foreign files and replacement names.
Missing platform key must not initialize an empty ledger over existing data.
Migrating local storage alone preserves every domain, identifier, amount and receipt byte.
